<?php

class ResourcePool {
    private array $allocated = [];
    private array $freed = [];
    
    public function allocate(string $id, $resource): void {
        $this->allocated[$id] = $resource;
    }
    
    public function release(string $id): void {
        if (isset($this->allocated[$id])) {
            $this->freed[$id] = $this->allocated[$id];
            unset($this->allocated[$id]);
        }
    }
    
    public function isAllocated(string $id): bool {
        return isset($this->allocated[$id]);
    }
    
    public function isFreed(string $id): bool {
        return isset($this->freed[$id]);
    }
    
    public function reclaimFreed(string $id): void {
        if (isset($this->freed[$id])) {
            unset($this->freed[$id]);
        }
    }
}

class CircuitBreaker {
    private int $failureCount = 0;
    private int $threshold;
    private string $state = 'CLOSED';
    private ?float $openedAt = null;
    private float $cooldown;
    
    public function __construct(int $threshold = 3, float $cooldown = 30.0) {
        $this->threshold = $threshold;
        $this->cooldown = $cooldown;
    }
    
    public function getState(): string {
        if ($this->state === 'OPEN' && $this->openedAt !== null) {
            if ((microtime(true) - $this->openedAt) >= $this->cooldown) {
                $this->state = 'HALF_OPEN';
            }
        }
        return $this->state;
    }
    
    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->failureCount++;
        if ($this->failureCount >= $this->threshold) {
            $this->state = 'OPEN';
            $this->openedAt = microtime(true);
        }
    }
    
    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->failureCount = 0;
        $this->state = 'CLOSED';
        $this->openedAt = null;
    }
    
    public function isCallPermitted(): bool {
        $state = $this->getState();
        return $state === 'CLOSED' || $state === 'HALF_OPEN';
    }
}

class SmartContract {
    private ResourcePool $pool;
    private CircuitBreaker $breaker;
    private array $pendingRollbacks = [];
    private array $executionLog = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->pool = new ResourcePool();
        $this->breaker = new CircuitBreaker(3, 5.0);
    }
    
    public function executeTransaction(string $txId, callable $operation): array {
        if (!$this->breaker->isCallPermitted()) {
            return ['status' => 'rejected', 'reason' => 'circuit_open'];
        }
        
        $resourceId = 'res_' . $txId;
        $this->pool->allocate($resourceId, ['tx' => $txId, 'timestamp' => time()]);
        
        try {
            $result = $operation($txId);
            $this->breaker->recordSuccess();
            $this->executionLog[] = ['tx' => $txId, 'status' => 'success'];
            $this->finalizeResource($resourceId, true);
            return ['status' => 'success', 'result' => $result];
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->breaker->recordFailure();
            $this->executionLog[] = ['tx' => $txId, 'status' => 'failed', 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
            $this->scheduleRollback($resourceId, $txId);
            return ['status' => 'failed', 'error' => $e->getMessage()];
        }
    }
    
    private function finalizeResource(string $resourceId, bool $commit): void {
        $this->pool->release($resourceId);
        if ($commit) {
            $this->pool->reclaimFreed($resourceId);
        }
    }
    
    private function scheduleRollback(string $resourceId, string $txId): void {
        $this->pendingRollbacks[$txId] = $resourceId;
        $this->pool->release($resourceId);
    }
    
    public function processRollbacks(): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($this->pendingRollbacks as $txId => $resourceId) {
            $results[$txId] = $this->executeRollback($resourceId, $txId);
        }
        $this->pendingRollbacks = [];
        return $results;
    }
    
    private function executeRollback(string $resourceId, string $txId): string {
        if ($this->pool->isFreed($resourceId)) {
            $this->pool->reclaimFreed($resourceId);
            return 'rolled_back';
        }
        
        if ($this->pool->isAllocated($resourceId)) {
            $this->pool->release($resourceId);
            return 'released';
        }
        
        return 'no_action';
    }
    
    public function batchExecute(array $transactions): array {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($transactions as $tx) {
            $results[$tx['id']] = $this->executeTransaction($tx['id'], $tx['op']);
        }
        
        $rollbackResults = $this->processRollbacks();
        
        return ['executions' => $results, 'rollbacks' => $rollbackResults];
    }
    
    public function getState(): array {
        return [
            'circuit' => $this->breaker->getState(),
            'log' => $this->executionLog,
            'pending_rollbacks' => count($this->pendingRollbacks)
        ];
    }
}

// Usage demonstration

    ['id' => 'tx_003', 'op' => function($id) { return "processed_$id"; }],
